question: Which ERC-4337, wallet, permit and stablecoin contracts on Base are deployed and verified, and what are their addresses and audit links, as of 2026-10-08?

frame.exposure: smart-account creation, sponsored gas, signature-based token approval, USDC transfer

item.title: ERC-4337 EntryPoint v0.7 and v0.8 on Base

findings.finding: Base: EntryPoint v0.7 0x0000000071727De22E5E9d8BAf0edAc6f37da032 (Sourcify exact_match, EntryPoint, 32,073 hex chars) and EntryPoint v0.8 0x4337084D9E255Ff0702461CF8895CE9E3b5Ff108 (Sourcify exact_match, EntryPoint, 43,479 hex chars). The v0.7 EntryPoint exposes senderCreator() and is not a proxy.

Audit directory https://github.com/eth-infinitism/account-abstraction/tree/develop/audits lists the 2023-02 incremental audit, the 2024-02-20 incremental report, a Spearbit review of March 2025 and a v0.9 Cantina security review.

notFound: Bundler and Pimlico or Alchemy paymaster addresses were not read.

item.title: Coinbase Smart Wallet factory, implementation and VerifyingPaymaster on Base

findings.finding: Factories on Base: 0x0BA5ED0c6AA8c49038F819E587E2633c4A9F428a (Sourcify exact_match, CoinbaseSmartWalletFactory) and 0xBA5ED110eFDBa3D005bfC882d75358ACBbB85842 (exact_match, CoinbaseSmartWalletFactory). factory.implementation() of the first returned 0x000100abaad02f1cfC8Bbe32bD5a564817339E72 (exact_match, CoinbaseSmartWallet); initCodeHash() 0x5153041b4b8e36c84ca233b2fb610f85b8831b5e56a365618f507f8784fe034e.
A VerifyingPaymaster 0x2FAEB0760D4230Ef2aC21496Bb4F0b47D634FD4c is verified on Base (exact_match, VerifyingPaymaster); that it is the Coinbase operated paymaster was not established by the read.
Audit directory https://github.com/coinbase/smart-wallet/tree/main/audits lists Cantina December 2023, Certora February 2024, Code4rena March 2024 and Cantina April 2024.

notFound: RIP-7212 (secp256r1) precompile on Base was not read.
